sections.body_md: Begin with Type Four meaning attention, then ask whether visible delivery repeatedly modifies how expression is shaped. Public fluency without identity concern may reflect Three themes, profession, training, or platform rules.
sections.title: Keep identity and meaning at the core

sections.body_md: Compared with 4w5 private depth, 4w3 may move expression toward an audience. Compared with Three, the proposed core remains personal meaning and authorship rather than the valued result itself.
sections.title: Contrast 4w3 with 4w5 and Three

sections.body_md: Use one credited work, one anonymous contribution, and one revision after weak audience response. Record which meaning is protected, which presentation changes, and how credit affects effort.
sections.title: Compare credited, anonymous, and revised work

sections.body_md: The hypothesis weakens when expression stays private by preference, visible polish appears only for a job, or audience response does not alter presentation or authorship concerns.
sections.title: Use private continuity and role-only visibility as tests

sections.body_md: Creative industries, fundraising, teaching, and online platforms can reward personal visibility. Compare behavior outside rewarded settings and when credit, pay, and audience access change.
sections.title: Test portfolio and promotion requirements

sections.body_md: Wing research is sparse. The hypothesis cannot establish charisma, creativity, authenticity, employability, influence, or future recognition.
sections.title: Keep visible expression evidence limited

sections.body_md:
Duration: 5

Context: Choose a credited work, an anonymous contribution, and one revision after weak response with comparable effort.

Observable signal: Record meaning protected, credit available, audience, revision, reward, authorship claim, and effort after no recognition.

Page-specific signal: Compare the exact presentation change when authorship is visible versus anonymous while the underlying work stays similar.

Alternative explanation: Compare portfolio rules, promotion incentives, platform design, communication training, pay, and access.

Reflection prompt: Identify where professional visibility explains the pattern without a 4w3 modifier.

seo.description: The 4w3 wing is a core-first, evidence-limited hypothesis: Type Four attention to identity and meaning may be modified by Three-adjacent visible delivery, audience recognition, and adaptation. A polished personal brand cannot establish a wing because portfolio rules, promotion incentives, and communication training can look the same.
seo.title: 4w3: visible expression as a core-first wing hypothesis
